_comment: MALE clip set. Clip name -> UE AnimSequence asset path. Names are the runtime's state-map keys - do not rename them. Idle/Listening/Speaking supplied by the owner 2026-08-20 from the gendered pack; Shrug is AN_Idle_13, shared with the female set at the owner's direction. Focused is gendered as of 2026-08-20, replacing Focused_Anim_Salute whose hand collided with the head (#3255). Thinking and the remaining gestures are unchanged from the single shared set and still point at the previous pack, which UE moved to /Game/Animations/previousPack/ when the gendered pack was installed. Those four slots are the ones still awaiting gendered replacements.
